statement: Every nontrivial countable one-variable mixed-identity-free group, every countably infinite torsion-free two-conjugacy-class group, and every nonabelian countable uniformly simple group admits an explicit unsolvable countable equation system with identity exponent matrix. For any subgroup K of a torsion-free source H and any epimorphism q:K to such a target E, lifting coefficients into K yields an actual homology-equivalence inclusion BH into BP, obtained by countably many one- and two-cells, with H embedded and normally generating P, but with no homomorphism P to E restricting to q on K. No extension of q to H is assumed. Thus an actual two-dimensional model is preserved. The full countable-system solution property passes to quotients, and countable existentially closed groups fail it.
depends_on: A.18 (the checked Forester--Rourke geometric one-pair input only)
manuscript_pages_settled: A3(iii): exact simultaneous-system obstruction for three specified classes of countable targets, with actual two-dimensional coefficient-injective homology-equivalence extensions
notes: Root discovered the chain diagonal construction; D independently audited it and proved the finite-branching uniformly simple extension; C independently audited both. No October 2026 nonsingular-system result is required. This does not assert that every countable target containing a prescribed perfect coefficient group belongs to, or has a detecting quotient in, any of the three classes. It does not assert that the constructed countable extension itself has no other countable images. The source group may be uncountable; only its target and the attached block are countable.
